name: Camera
explanation: Lets the app take photos and record video using your device's camera.
misuseExample: A malicious app could secretly take photos or record video without you knowing.

name: Microphone
explanation: Lets the app record audio using your device's microphone.
misuseExample: A malicious app could listen in on conversations or record audio in the background.

name: Contacts
explanation: Lets the app read, and sometimes modify, your contacts list.
misuseExample: A malicious app could harvest your entire contacts list to sell or use for spam/phishing targeting people you know.

name: Location
explanation: Lets the app access your device's GPS location, either precisely or approximately.
misuseExample: A malicious app could track your movements over time, revealing where you live, work, or go regularly.

name: SMS
explanation: Lets the app read, send, or intercept text messages.
misuseExample: A malicious app could intercept one-time passcodes sent via SMS, bypassing two-factor authentication on your other accounts.

name: Storage
explanation: Lets the app read and write files on your device's storage (photos, downloads, documents).
misuseExample: A malicious app could search your files for sensitive documents, screenshots, or saved images.

name: Accessibility Service
explanation: Designed to help users with disabilities interact with their device, but grants extremely broad access to see and control what's on your screen.
misuseExample: A malicious app could read anything on screen, including banking app passwords, and even simulate taps on your behalf.

name: Device Admin
explanation: Gives the app elevated control over device security settings.
misuseExample: A malicious app could prevent itself from being uninstalled or lock you out of your own device.

name: Phone State
explanation: Lets the app see your phone number, device ID, and call status.
misuseExample: Used to uniquely track and fingerprint your device across apps, even if you reset other identifiers.

name: Calendar
explanation: Lets the app read or add events in your calendar.
misuseExample: A malicious app could see your schedule, revealing when you're away from home.

name: Body Sensors
explanation: Lets the app access health-related sensors, such as heart rate monitors.
misuseExample: Could be used to infer sensitive health information without your awareness.

name: Call Logs
explanation: Lets the app read or modify your call history.
misuseExample: A malicious app could see who you've called, when, and for how long, building a picture of your relationships.

name: Bluetooth
explanation: Lets the app discover and connect to nearby Bluetooth devices.
misuseExample: Generally low risk, but can be used to track nearby devices for location inference.

name: Notifications
explanation: Lets the app read the content of your notifications from other apps.
misuseExample: A malicious app could read one-time codes or private messages that appear in notifications.

name: Internet
explanation: Lets the app connect to the internet — required by almost all apps.
misuseExample: Low risk alone, but necessary for any app to send stolen data elsewhere, so it matters more in combination with other permissions.
